text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in 5xx responses (502/504) from eu-north inference-gateway cluster. Error rate: 18% over 5m. Alert ID: A-1862501234. Paging on-call.
Alisa (oncall): seeing it in dashboards too. Clients report timeouts. Starting triage.
Alisa (oncall): @Raj can you confirm if any recent config pushes to the edge or gateways in eu-north?
Raj (infra): not aware of any infra deploys in the last hour. Let me check the deploy logs.
Raj (infra): `aws codepipeline list-pipeline-executions --pipeline-name infra-edge --max-items 5` -> no recent successful runs.
Miguel (sre): adding logs: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/gateway-eu-north --tail=200` shows repeated `upstream sent invalid response` and `connection reset` from proxy.
Tara (prod): multiple customers showing increased latencies and a few 502s. CS ticket #CS-1287 opened. Mentioned high QPS on long-context requests.
Ben (platform): running quick trace: p99 latency for token generation increased from 450ms to 1.9s. Heap / CPU on pods look normal.
Alisa (oncall): can we check the sidecar/proxy version? `kubectl get pods -o wide` shows proxy-image: `edge-proxy:2.14.0`
Miguel (sre): I see a pattern: backend inference pods returning OK but proxy logs show `failed to flush response headers` and repeated `TLS handshake failed: short record`. Possibly a TLS termination issue between proxy and backend.
Raj (infra): rolling check of certs: certs looked fine. But I see increased connection resets at the ALB layer: `ELB 504 cause: Idle connection timeout`. ALB idle timeout is default (60s).
Tara (prod): many of the failing requests are long-run prompts > 30s. Could be timing out at load balancer/proxy.
Alisa (oncall): mitigation: set ALB idle timeout to 300s for eu-north target group. Applying change now.
ops-pager: @Alisa change submitted: `aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn ... --attributes Key=idletimeout.timeout_seconds,Value=300`
Raj (infra): confirm ALB change applied. Monitoring...
Miguel (sre): while we wait, let's enable streaming fallback to bypass the proxy buffering. Patch ingress config: `kubectl patch ingress gateway -n inference -p '{"spec":{...}}'` (applied).
Ben (platform): traffic snapshot after ALB change: error rate dropped from 18% -> 9% in 2 minutes. Good sign.
Alisa (oncall): rolling restart of proxy pods to clear possible stale TLS sessions: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/gateway-proxy -n inference`
Tara (prod): CS updated customers: we notified impacted customers that we're mitigating and expect partial recovery.
Miguel (sre): After restart, proxy logs show fewer TLS errors, but some 502s still coming from a small subset of nodes. Traces point to 3 nodes with `kernel: TCP: RST` spikes.
Raj (infra): isolating those instances from the pool: marking unhealthy in target group so traffic bypasses them.
ops-pager: Marked 3 IPs (10.2.45.18, 10.2.45.22, 10.2.45.23) as draining.
Ben (platform): error rate down to 2% now, p99 back to ~550ms.
Alisa (oncall): good. I'm going to handoff to Miguel for deeper root cause and postmortem. @Miguel you own the rest of the incident.
Miguel (sre): taking over. Preliminary hypothesis: a kernel-level networking regression (host kernel bump during maintenance window) caused intermittent RSTs under long-lived connections. I'll correlate with host package updates.
Tara (prod): customers still seeing intermittent errors for some long prompts but overall much better. CS will follow up with affected accounts.
Miguel (sre): scheduling of on-call handoff: @Ben please take point if this resurfaces overnight.
Ben (platform): 👍 I'll be on rotation. Also recommend adding a Canary test that runs long-stream prompts to catch idle-timeout/TCP regressions.
Alisa (oncall): added runbook note: increase ALB idle timeout for long prompt workloads and verify proxy supports streaming.
Miguel (sre): next steps: (1) correlate host kernel updates in eu-north between 02:00-03:00 UTC (2) run repro load against the 3 drained hosts in staging (3) test TLS handshake patterns with newer proxy image 2.15.0 (4) postmortem doc + RCA and customer-facing summary.
ops-pager: Incident severity downgraded to SEV2 at 1862502834 (once error rate <5%).
Alisa (oncall): closing loop: thanks everyone. Please add any notes to the incident thread and I'll schedule the postmortem session tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
Miguel (sre): noted. Will upload logs and initial timeline to the doc.
Tara (prod): CS follow-up queued.
Alisa (oncall): final status: service health restored for eu-north with degraded impact window ~22 minutes. Will include mitigation steps + permanent fixes in postmortem. :white_check_mark:
